name: gnome-shell-extension-development
description: Create, debug, port, test, and package GNOME Shell extensions with current GJS practices.

interface.shortDescription: Build and debug GNOME Shell extensions
interface.longDescription: Develop maintainable GNOME Shell extensions with modern GJS modules, symmetric enable/disable cleanup, GTK 4 and Libadwaita preferences, version-aware porting, nested-session testing, packaging, and extensions.gnome.org review preparation.
defaultPrompt: Create or improve a GNOME Shell extension
